refs.purpose: Map Nextflow container/conda evidence to Galaxy UDT container and package provenance.
refs.trigger: When a missing Galaxy user-defined tool must be authored from a Nextflow process with container or conda directives.
refs.verification: Author one UDT from nf-core/bacass or nf-core/rnaseq process evidence and confirm the note improves requirements/container extraction.

refs.purpose: Map Nextflow container/conda evidence to Galaxy UDT container and package provenance.
refs.trigger: When a missing Galaxy user-defined tool must be authored from a Nextflow process with container or conda directives.

refs.purpose: Field contract, expression syntax, script placement, and package inference for a `GalaxyUserTool` definition.
Clarity and idiomaticity criteria, and the text-versus-structural test for each proposed fix.
refs.trigger: After the drafted `GalaxyUserTool` passes structural validation and before emitting `galaxy-user-tool.yml`.

refs.purpose: Choose datatypes from Nextflow path/glob evidence and its confidence rules; use the UDT field contract for final input/output syntax.
refs.trigger: When supplied Nextflow paths or output globs provide datatype evidence.
refs.verification: Confirm weak variable-name hints do not become invented formats and evidenced formats use UDT input lists and output strings.

refs.purpose: Interpret nf-core tuple/path input roles and cardinality; express the result using UDT-supported input shapes rather than copying XML examples.
refs.trigger: When supplied Nextflow evidence contains nf-core tuple(meta, path) inputs or single/paired branching.
refs.verification: Author from single-file and paired nf-core evidence; preserve cardinality or explicitly report an unsupported UDT shape.

refs.purpose: Distinguish behavior-driving meta keys from identity and naming metadata when building the UDT requirements brief.
refs.trigger: When supplied Nextflow script evidence reads meta-map keys.
refs.verification: Confirm identity-only keys do not become required UDT inputs and behavior-driving keys are retained or their narrowing is recorded.

refs.purpose: Interpret a supplied whole-pipeline Nextflow summary and resolve process evidence within it.
refs.trigger: When the optional summary-nextflow artifact is supplied; do not require a whole summary or apply its envelope schema to standalone process evidence.

produces.description: Galaxy `GalaxyUserTool` YAML definition for a tool not present on the Tool Shed.

consumes.description: Optional whole-pipeline Nextflow summary from [[summarize-nextflow]], when available; other source descriptions and standalone process evidence can supply the authoring context directly.
